populationDefinition: 人口构成使用2021年普查 Visible minority 表中的私人住户人口（25%抽样数据）。总人口另取完整人口统计，两个分母分别保留。
incomeDefinition: 2021年普查公布的2020年私人住户税前家庭总年收入中位数，单位为加元。范围基准直接采用该市镇或地区的官方中位数。GTA整体没有可用的同口径中位数，因此留空。
chineseDefinition: Chinese 采用2021年普查 Visible minority 分类。占比由该类别人数除以同一张表的私人住户人口计算。此分类与国籍、出生地或语言分别统计。
childrenDefinition: 0–14岁比例直接取自普查年龄分布表公布值，分母为总人口。
householdSizeDefinition: 平均私人住户人数采用普查直接公布值。
roundingNote: 普查人数经过随机取整，分类合计与人口分母可能存在小幅差异。GTA总体人口构成由五个地区官方总数相加，未使用普查区加总替代市镇或地区基准。
boundaryNote: 采用加拿大统计局2021年普查区边界，共1,339个普查区。Scugog、Brock及Mississaugas of Scugog Island没有普查区划分，地图在这三处展示整个市镇统计区并注明地理级别。边界联合简化以保留相邻区域的共同边线。
missingDataNote: 缺失、未公布和保密抑制值保留为空，明确公布的0保留为0。收入排名仅比较同一市镇内有公布收入的普查区，整个市镇统计区不参与排名。
latestCensusNote: 本图的人口和人口群体数据来自2021年联邦普查，收入参考年份为2020年。数据年份在详情中标出。
populationGroupsDefinition: 保留2021年普查的13个原始 Visible minority 分类。非可见少数族裔分类包含原住民，类别名称采用统计局定义。
populationChartNote: 圆环扇区按同表人数和私人住户人口计算。未选择的人群合并为灰色，原表统计差额留白。
license: 包含根据加拿大统计局开放许可发布的2021年普查统计和边界数据。Leaflet使用BSD 2-Clause许可。地图背景及交通来源见各项来源链接。
scopeNote: 范围覆盖Toronto、Peel、York、Durham及Halton，包括25个市镇及这五个地区内的两个第一民族普查统计区。普查区用所属市镇和官方编号标识。

english.populationDefinition: Population composition uses the population in private households from the 2021 Census visible-minority table (25% sample data). Total population is retained separately from the complete population count.
english.incomeDefinition: Median total before-tax income of private households in 2020, as published by the 2021 Census, in Canadian dollars. Scope benchmarks use the directly published municipality or regional median. The GTA-wide median is left unavailable because a comparable published total was not obtained.
english.chineseDefinition: Chinese is the original 2021 Census visible-minority category. Its share is the count divided by private-household population from the same table. Citizenship, birthplace and language are separate Census concepts.
english.childrenDefinition: The share aged 0–14 is the directly published Census age-distribution percentage of the total population.
english.householdSizeDefinition: Average household size is the directly published average number of people in private households.
english.roundingNote: Census counts are randomly rounded, so category totals can differ slightly from the population denominator. GTA population composition sums the five official census-division totals. Municipal and regional benchmarks use their directly published totals.
english.boundaryNote: The map uses 1,339 official 2021 Statistics Canada census tracts. Scugog, Brock and Mississaugas of Scugog Island have no census-tract coverage; these three locations display their entire census subdivisions with the geography level identified. Boundaries are simplified together to preserve shared edges.
english.missingDataNote: Missing, unpublished and confidentially suppressed values stay unavailable; published zeros stay zero. Income ranks compare reported census tracts within the same municipality. Municipality-level fallback areas are excluded from tract rankings.
english.latestCensusNote: Population and population-group statistics come from the 2021 federal Census; income refers to 2020. The detail panel identifies these reference years.
english.populationGroupsDefinition: The 13 original 2021 Census visible-minority categories are retained. The “Not a visible minority” category includes Indigenous people. Category names follow Statistics Canada definitions.
english.populationChartNote: Ring segments use counts and the private-household population from the same table. Unselected categories are grey and differences in the original table remain unfilled.
english.license: Contains 2021 Census statistics and boundaries released under the Statistics Canada Open Licence. Leaflet uses the BSD 2-Clause licence. Basemap and transport sources are listed individually.
english.scopeNote: Coverage includes Toronto, Peel, York, Durham and Halton, comprising 25 municipalities and two First Nations census subdivisions. Census tracts are identified by their municipality and official tract number.
english.transitDefinition: Routes and stations use official GTFS snapshots; operating status was checked on November 6, 2026. The map displays geographic routes, with no real-time arrivals or daily service information.
english.geographyDefinition: Context geometry uses official Ontario, Toronto and federal data. Parks combine protected and conserved areas and Toronto municipal parks of at least 5 hectares.

transitDefinition: 交通线路与站点来自官方GTFS快照，线路运营状态核对日期为2026-11-06。地图展示地理线路，不提供实时到站或当日服务安排。
geographyDefinition: 地理背景来自安省、多伦多市及加拿大联邦官方数据。绿地包含保护地和多伦多市面积至少5公顷的市属公园。
